summary: Read-only and Rebase clicks did nothing because the webview dropped chooseMode. The test names that gap; the extracted allowlists include it in both sets; sidebar.ts forwards the payload again.

.tabthrough-guide.json.rationale: The sidecar this walk is written into

steps.title: Mode picker must reach chooseMode
steps.rationale: The failure the rest of the diff answers — clicks posted a command the allowlist dropped
steps.notes: Both sets are required. SIDEBAR_COMMANDS lets the message through; PAYLOAD_COMMANDS is what actually forwards `readonly` or `rebase`. Missing either one looks like a dead button.

steps.title: chooseMode is on both allowlists
steps.rationale: The contract the test above asserts — extracted so the test can import it without vscode
steps.notes: `chooseMode` sits with setupBack in the message set and with selectCommit in the payload set. The payload set is the one that was easy to forget: without it the handler runs with no mode and still does nothing.

steps.title: Webview imports the shared allowlists
steps.rationale: First consumer — the message handler that used to keep the sets inline and omit chooseMode
